title: Unraveling oxygen vacancy-driven catalytic hydrogen evolution activity and stability over atomic layer-deposited platinum cluster catalysts
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07690K, Paper
Xinshuo Zhao, Xiangbin Kong, Ruokun Zhang, Hao Xu, Jiawei Yao, Yutong Feng, Yurong He, Yong Qin, Jiankang Zhang
Independent modulation of the oxygen vacancy (Ov) concentration in MoO3−x is achieved while preserving a nearly unchanged Pt particle size, and a clear volcano-shape relationship between Ov concentration and catalytic activity is established.
